resolvedQuestions: Orca's session-list/card model is a structured, host-scanned projection with deterministic filtering, grouping, attention ordering, peek, and single-flight resume.
Message copy, scroll-to-turn, role-aware rows, bounded tool folding, and scoped context-menu presentation are portable; mutation semantics require separate evidence.
Composer attachments, paste classification, dictation state, file/command suggestions, prompt history, and serialized option dispatch are portable as scoped UI flows.
Incremental assembly, optimistic reconciliation, ask cards, and Stop outcomes improve trust when stale and unknown outcomes remain visibly unresolved.
Title, preview, attention, redacted identity, capabilities, artifact references, and follow intent are host-dependent; client-owned metadata and raw-path actions are not portable.
